page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Running head at the top, centred. No marginal notes, no page number, no catchword, no signature.

main_text.p: defideret ut ampliores ex artibus Rhetorum locos, laudibus tuis celebrandis conquiram[?]ad id enim virtutu omnium fastigium adscendisti, ut cuncta ista, quæ vel de egregiis Heroïbus exspectantur, vel facunde prædicantur, vita superaueris. Elucet in Celsitudine tua SANCTITAS DOMI, IN ARMIS FORTITVDO, UTROBIQVE PRVDENTIA, in actionibus certe cunctis SINCERITAS & CONSTANTIA: conspicua est summa tua erga studia literarum LIBERALITAS & MVNIFICENTIA. Testimonium nobis locupletissimum præbet collegiu CASIMIRIANVM, adeo eleganter & magnifice sumtibus tuis constructum, ut intuentibus admirationi, Heidelbergensi Academiç honori, totiq; Palatinatui emolumento sit futurum. O felicem diem, quo fundamentum iecisti, & amplissimum hoc Musarum palatium nomine tuo appellasti!

page.notes: Small-capital and italic words set in caps are transcribed in plain capitals. The word "virtutu" may carry a tilde over the u; not clear enough to add. "conquiram?ad" has an unclear mark between "conquiram" and "ad", marked [?]. The final word "appellasti!" runs on to the right end of the last line. The printed "Academiç" has a mark that may be a q-abbreviation; kept as printed with [?] to be checked. Long s is plain s throughout.
